name: The Tome of Divinity

meta.previous: Tome of Divinity (Brother Wilhelm) / Tome of Divinity (5)

summary: In Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall guides you through a solemn rite for young paladins. Its teachings test your virtue and devotion to the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Paladin's Calling
sections.body: Your training now reaches beyond arms and the order's rites. Duthorian's trials ask you to weigh a paladin's moral duties and grasp the deeper promise your calling demands. Those who depend on the Holy Light need defenders who understand what that duty means.

sections.title: The Path of Virtue
sections.body: The Book of Divinity binds you to service and self-sacrifice. Duthorian asks you to study its holy text and learn what the Light demands of its defenders. Its lessons prepare you to oppose the Scourge's creeping horrors and protect common folk. Virtue and compassion must guide your power.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Tome of Divinity?
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity tests whether a new paladin understands sacred principles. Before greater divine abilities are entrusted to an initiate, devotion and virtue must ground their strength alongside martial skill.
Duthorian Rall is a senior paladin trainer in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He guides new paladins, gives them the Book of Divinity, and directs their trials across the kingdom.

faq.q: Where does this trial take place?
faq.answer: The trial begins inside the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City's Cathedral Square. After preliminary duties in outer townships such as Goldshire, initiates report to Duthorian Rall.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge mentioned in Stormwind's teachings?
faq.answer: The Scourge devastated Lordaeron to the north, but its undead still threaten all living mortals. Stormwind's paladins learn to recognize and fight the Scourge's unholy corruption wherever it appears across Azeroth.

faq.q: What comes after reading the Book of Divinity?
faq.answer: Reading the Book of Divinity is only the first step. Duthorian Rall tests whether you have taken its lessons to heart by sending you to aid those in dire need, where your deeds must prove compassion and resilience.

faq.q: Who normally directs candidates to Duthorian Rall?
faq.answer: Local instructors and clergy in Elwynn's outlying settlements can direct candidates to Duthorian Rall. Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire is one such guide, sending initiates to the capital when they are ready for formal trials.

angles.text: As a paladin, this rite marks your passage from apprentice of arms to servant of the Holy Light. It teaches the sacrifice and mercy at the heart of the order.
As a human of Stormwind, you honor the fallen knights of Lordaeron and carry on the Silver Hand's proud tradition in the southern kingdom.
As an Alliance member, your training strengthens Stormwind's heart and prepares its paladins to shield the Alliance from rising darkness.
